result.instructions: Tools for TeamSnap, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which teams am I on, and what is coming up for them this week?"; "Who is on the roster of my U12 team, and who is a manager?"; "What events are scheduled for my team in the next 14 days, and where?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TeamSnap data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run teamsnap_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run teamsnap_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run teamsnap_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. teamsnap_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: teamsnap_get_me
tools.title: Get my TeamSnap profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in TeamSnap user, including the user id that teamsnap_list_teams uses. TeamSnap API: GET /v3/me.

tools.name: teamsnap_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams a user belongs to, with name, sport, season and league. Without user_id, the signed-in user is used (one extra call to /v3/me). TeamSnap API: GET /v3/teams?userId=.

user_id.description: TeamSnap user id. Omit it to list the teams of the signed-in user.

tools.name: teamsnap_list_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the members (roster) of a team: name, position, jersey number, manager flag and team id. TeamSnap API: GET /v3/members?teamId=.

tools.name: teamsnap_list_events
tools.title: List team events
tools.description: List the events (games, practices and other events) of a team with start date, duration, location id and status. TeamSnap API: GET /v3/events?teamId=.

tools.name: teamsnap_list_locations
tools.title: List team locations
tools.description: List the saved locations (fields, venues) of a team. Use a location id in teamsnap_create_event. TeamSnap API: GET /v3/locations?teamId=.

tools.name: teamsnap_create_event
tools.title: Create team event
tools.description: Create a practice or other event for a team. This WRITES to TeamSnap. Team members are not notified unless notify_team is true (default false). TeamSnap API: POST /v3/events.

start_date.description: Start date and time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00.

duration_in_minutes.description: Length of the event in minutes.

notify_team.description: Email the team about the new event (default false).
